mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and, by extension, a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE is below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, above 2% indicates a growing supply of goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, and a low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a growing demand for goods and services and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when RSAFS and UNRATE are high (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, and an increase in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicate an expansionary monetary policy and growing inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is low and CPIAUCSL is high (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate, as measured by PAYEMS, above 140,000, and a low unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, below 5%, indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS is high and UNRATE is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP, as measured by GDPC1, above 2% indicates a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
